assets.name: rider
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite for a polished Vietnamese alley 2D lane-runner game. Strict orthographic straight-down view, clean deliberate dark ink contours, restrained cel shading with just 3 tones per material, warm muted colors, crisp silhouette readable at 64 pixels. Hand-drawn indie game aesthetic, no noisy texture, no painterly smudges, no photorealism, no 3D render, no glow, no lettering. One isolated object centered with narrow transparent margins; genuine transparent background. A single beautiful teal Vietnamese motor scooter WITH rider, viewed vertically from directly above. Front wheel and headlight at TOP, rear wheel at BOTTOM. Long narrow silhouette height twice width including mirrors. Rider wears round cream helmet, rust orange jacket, both hands naturally on handlebars, dark pants; small tan delivery parcel strapped behind seat. Clearly recognizable scooter body with front fairing, two mirrors, black tires. Symmetrical, no side view.
